items.text: 30 done, 1 done differently, 1 for you to check, 2 not reproduced, 3 your notes, left alone
one per place, each over its whole block, tunable in the fade tuner
the hero title at 1440: it fills its cell

blocks.note: Round 4 (main) in grey, round 5 in blue, at the size each caption names. Click a picture to open it large; arrows and Escape work.

items.title: The hero's fade (1440)

items.ask: The gradients should be eased, no solid colours like in the hero; an artifact to tweak them
items.done: Four fades, one per place (colors.json fades: hero, caption, panel, card), each laid over the whole block it stands under; no solid band anywhere, and a rule now refuses a fade with a band under it. The fade tuner: the built home page in a frame, a curve editor (with the presets of tw-easing-gradients), reach, stops and lead-in per fade, five screen sizes; «Save for Claude» keeps the values for the next commit.

items.ask: The scroll position should not change on changing the window's size
items.done: The first block that starts under the navbar stays where it stood (scripts/scroll.js). Only a change of width counts, and never during a scroll, so a phone's fling is not stopped when its toolbar hides. Measured: the business heading moves only by its section's shrinking padding (200 → 149px at 500 wide).

items.ask: On hover these change the ground of their own container to semi-transparent cool grey or white: navbar links and icons, the 3 hero links, the page numbers, the arrows, the card's 2 buttons, the heart
items.done: Every one of them tints its own cell with --tint (ink 6% on light, white 20% on dark and photo cards). Nothing moves on hover anywhere (icons, photo zooms): a new rule, «Hovers never move».

items.ask: In the focused state nothing should be changed
items.done: A pointer lights nothing: the modal now opens with the focus on its box, scripts move focus without a ring after a click (scripts/focus.js), text fields keep their border. For the keyboard the ring stays (Tab, Enter, Esc work as before).

items.ask: 3D packs: remove the lag on scroll
items.done: No lag on the page's scroll or a row's slide, no tilt when sliding. Only a card rising into place still carries its pack up.

items.ask: 3D packs: on click moving away a bit, on hold stays moved away
items.done: A press anywhere on the card (not its buttons) moves the pack away (lift −0.45, scale 0.94) and holds it while the pointer is down; before it took a press on the pack itself.

items.ask: The links should be in 1 group (now there are 3)
items.done: One row, every text 16px from the next.

items.ask: Change the profile icon to the actual one from Figma
items.done: Exported from the Figma navbar (profile, 24px), drawn in the current colour.

items.ask: The ground of the links on hover larger, padding around the text even; the gap stays, no movement
items.done: The tint 14px beside the text (was 8): 16px text in a 40px cell has 13px over its capitals and 15 under its baseline. It is drawn 6px wider than the link, so the texts stay and the pointer passes from one link to the next in the middle of the gap.

items.ask: 1. The title should shape the height of the whole bottom container; on larger screens its size should be larger than now
items.done: From L the title fills its cell («обжарки» 4.55em from the cell's edge to its padding), capped at its size at the column's 1520: 55.1 61.1px at 1024, 63.1 88.3 at 1440, 64 90.3 from 1920. From 1366 its lines set the cells' height (326px at 1440); narrower, the countdown's digits are taller and the rows lead (275 vs a 239px title at 1024). Decision hero-title-fills-cell.

items.ask: 2. The inner container should have left and right borders from the max width — on larger screens it disappears; the same for the 3 blocks and the footer
items.done: The frame is there from the column's 1520px, at 1920 and 2560, in Chromium, for the hero, the info blocks and the footer. I could not make it disappear: at which width and in which browser did you see it go?

items.ask: 3. On hover a link's icon shouldn't move
items.done: It stays; only the ground tints.

items.ask: 4. Lines should always run full width (now on smaller screens they don't); the same for the 3 blocks and the footer
items.done: Below the column's max every hairline between cells runs out to the screen's edges on the sides where the column ends (a line with --out-l / --out-r of the gutter): the hero's link lines end 0px from the screen's edge at 1440 (before 47). From 1520 the block is framed and the lines stop at the frame.

items.ask: 5. On load the 3-column block moves to its place from opacity 0 and from below, with its outer container and top border
items.done: The whole block rises: the fade, the hairline above it and the cells, one section gap over 0.9s.

items.ask: 6. The text after the «i» optically centred, up to 16px
items.done: 16px at every size (before 12.1 on a phone), trimmed to its capitals and baseline and balanced, so it is centred by what you see; it takes the place of the digits and caption.

items.ask: 7. The «i» icon should stay selected after a click
items.done: It keeps the hover tint while the note is open.

items.done: Measured in Chromium: the pager's middle is the head's and the screen's middle within 0px at 390, 700, 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1920 (the number inside each ring within 0.4px). Where did it look off (size, browser)?

items.ask: 2. The 4-qualities cell: more space left and right, so the padding feels even
items.done: Its sides get the air its rows have above them (12px + (1.75em − the capitals) / 2): text to the edge 20 / 15px left / top at 1440 (before 12 / 15); centred where the pills make the box taller.

items.ask: 3. The picture should not move on hover

items.ask: 2. Packs outside the container shouldn't be visible; they disappear the opposite way of how they appear
items.done: Cards show only inside the column: one comes in when half of it is in and rises, one leaves as soon as it starts crossing the edge and sinks away (0.45s, the rise reversed); its pack goes with it, upright. items.done: The buy row's fade (its 56px lead-in) took the clicks; it now lets them through to the card's link. Measured: no dead point on the recommended and catalog cards.

items.ask: 4. The whole left button should be clickable as one
items.done: A click anywhere in the weights cell picks the other weight; it tints as one on hover.

items.ask: 2. The whole cards should be links

items.ask: 3. The arrow shouldn't move
items.done: It stays.

items.ask: 2. The plus closer to the corner (Figma)

items.ask: 3. The transition to the open version is not seamless or smooth (both ways)

items.ask: 2. «Расскажем о появлении скидок и новинок» and the field as 2 equal columns, when available
items.done: From M: 309 / 309px at 1440 (before stacked); below M the line over the field.

blocks.title: What this changes that you may not expect
items: Over the photo the cells are no longer solid black: the photo shows faintly behind the title, the countdown and the links, and on the business cards and the business page's offers the text sits where the fade is 33–38% (the lightest pixels behind an offer title give 2.4:1). The fade tuner can set a curve that darkens sooner, or a reach under 1.
The hero's title is bigger at L (62 → 90px), so at 1440 × 900 the photo above the cells is 20px shorter.

No hover moves anything any more: the photo zooms of the cards, the business cards, the offers and the places, and the sliding arrows of the hero, the business cards, the «Читать» buttons and the row links are gone everywhere, not only where you named them.
Text fields no longer change their border when clicked; the caret is the only sign (the keyboard still gets the ring).
Recommended cards in the margins are gone: at 1920 the right margin no longer shows the next card (a question from round 3).

blocks.title: Round 5's measures at 25 screens
blocks.sub: Round 4 (main) struck, round 5 after it. Title: its size; cells: the height of the title and of the cells (from L the title leads when they match). Line: how far from the screen's edge the hero's link lines end (0: at the edge; at the frame from 1520). Nav: the hover ground's air beside a link's text. Taste: text to the cell's left / top edge. Gap: business lead → cards (top: above the heading). Plus: from the block's right / top edge. Step: the modal's step row.
